tools.name: get_public_tender
tools.description: The public page of one notice, by its Scoutee identifier (the `id` of a search result). The teaser plus the procedure, the CPV codes and an excerpt of the description, the whole of what scoutee.org shows an anonymous visitor. The description in full, the buyer's platform link and the tender document
